premises.text: Brand-retailer collaboration for in-store execution is broken, relying on phones, emails, and inefficient store visits while purchase decisions happen in store
premises.evidence_span: the collaboration is broken. Brands and retailers are still relying on multiple phone calls and emails and very expensive and inefficient store visits

premises.text: A collaboration platform lets brands run campaigns, collect in-store data, and use image detection while store staff execute tasks and brands get real-time merchandising insights
premises.evidence_span: in-store execution requires a new collaboration platform

premises.text: Crowdsourcing community of consumers can collect in-store data on brands' behalf as an alternative channel
premises.evidence_span: she can decide to use our crowdsourcing community of 50,000 consumers to collect the data on her behalf

premises.text: SaaS charges per user per company, with a five-day go-live onboarding program
premises.evidence_span: We have a SaaS business model where we charge on a per-user, per-company basis

domains.name: SaaS per-user pricing and fast go-live

value.text: Improve in-store execution so brands and retailers increase sales
value.evidence_span: We increased sales for our customer by an average of 25%

causal_links.evidence_span: poor in-store execution will result in 20 billion euro of lost revenue
